title: Jacqueline I Am Coming
overview: When a 40-year-old government employee Kashi Tewary stumbles upon local beauty Jacqueline at a church, he is instantaneously drawn towards her. But, like most love-at-first-sight stories, this one, too, has its fair share of obstacles to overcome.
